Before this we only used to supply the product and it would go in the market in the trade and we would not know exactly where the application is going and what the customer is expecting.
So I would not like to overcommit but I can still consider like a 60% growth is what we are anticipating overall this year.
Growth & demand: We have done a 40% growth compared to year -on-year of the Q1.
We would be looking to do anywhere around anywhere between 160 170 with the 40% growth rate that we are already doing right now.

Eventually the reduction of cost, but initially it would be the reduction of size.
Because you, I think right now we alluded to 15% sales realization growth.
Capex & expansion: And we are also already in the process of smaller capex and smaller investments to increase our manufacturing capabilities for these products further.
So where you have to even design the lights, supply the lights, install, commission and end-to-end give a complete solution for those kind of projects.

Guidance & outlook: How confident are you of the W225 crore OEM/ODM target by 20307 We have had these experiences in the past.
For FY27 also, we might not look at any major capex, because the capexes done in FY25 are now converting into business.
But I'm hoping capex in FY26-27 will be within a range of up to W5 crores - including planned automations in our manufacturing unit to reduce manual labour and increase efficiency.
Growth & demand: At one point in time, we were doing 100% year-on-year growth, which is only possible because of those manufacturing expansion capabilities.
At least around 25-30% growth is what we have in mind for the current year.

If we had B100 crores today, we would: (1) Acquire one or two companies for around B20 crores, which would give inorganic revenue growth of at least 30 crores instantly; (2) Invest around B15-20 crores worth of capex including in BESS and our current manufacturing facility; and (3) Keep around M50 crores for working capital to power that revenue growth.
